title: Provincetown and Cape Cod High Speed Ferry to/from Boston
includes: See magnificent views of the Boston Skyline and Boston Harbor Islands during your sail
Full service Concierge Desk aboard the ferry to help plan your trip
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
For round trip, you will need to purchase two separate one way tickets - one departing from Boston and one departing from Cape Cod.
Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure. Guests must arrive early, as late arrivals will miss the boat.
Infants are REQUIRED to have tickets.
Not recommended for guests who are prone to motion sickness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Situated on the Cape's northern-most tip, Provincetown is known for its art galleries, shopping, restaurants, landmarks, picturesque beaches and more. With our high-speed catamaran, all of this is just a 90 minute ride away!
